items.html: Know that the point that was emanated first is her Keter, and it is one point alone. And at first, before the pregnancy, it was at the end of the Yesod, below it. And during the time of the pregnancy it rose upon the Yesod and clothed it, and grew, and became like the measure and size of the Yesod. And in nursing it rose up to the Tifferet, at its back, and grew to the very measure of the Tifferet.
